title: Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Msamaha (Theme 10: Kujithamini)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child finds the parts of an official apology letter and its message: what happened, the apology and the promise.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the parts of an official letter.
floor.question: Barua rasmi ina anwani ngapi?

contexts: a letter to the head teacher

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child labels the parts and the three message parts.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Barua rasmi ina anwani ngapi?" Kwa nini "moja" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Barua rasmi huwa na nini kabla ya ujumbe?" Kwa nini "hakuna kitu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Barua rasmi ina kichwa cha barua.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Lugha ya barua rasmi ni ipi?" Kwa nini "ya mtaani" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha ya heshima na sanifu.

listen_for: Basi la shule lilichelewa na dereva alikuwa mzembe.
misconceptions.repair: Barua ya kuomba msamaha huomba msamaha wazi na kuahidi kubadilika.

checks.question: Barua ya kuomba msamaha ina sehemu zipi za ujumbe?
Kichwa cha barua rasmi huanza na?

skills.key_step: The child plans barua rasmi before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: ombi la msamaha kwa kuchelewa shuleni
a letter or story for a family member

board.do: Ombi la Msamaha kwa Kuchelewa Shuleni

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Ombi la Msamaha kwa Kuchelewa Shuleni".

misconceptions.ask: Barua hii itamfikia nani? Anwani yake iko wapi?
misconceptions.repair: Barua rasmi ina anwani mbili: ya mwandishi kulia juu, ya mpokeaji kushoto chini yake.

listen_for: Nimeandika barua hii kwa sababu ninataka kukueleza mambo mengi.
misconceptions.ask: Msomaji atajuaje barua inahusu nini bila kuisoma yote?
misconceptions.repair: Kichwa cha barua rasmi huanza KUH: au YAH: na huandikwa kwa herufi kubwa, kwa ufupi.

misconceptions.ask: Ungemsalimu Mwalimu Mkuu hivi katika mkutano rasmi?
misconceptions.repair: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha rasmi: Kwa Mwalimu Mkuu, Wako mtiifu.

misconceptions.ask: Mpokeaji atajuaje ni nani hasa aliyeandika?
misconceptions.repair: Barua rasmi humalizika kwa "Wako mtiifu," sahihi na jina kamili.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika barua rasmi kuhusu "Ombi la Msamaha kwa Kuchelewa Shuleni"?
Barua rasmi ina sehemu zipi?
checks.answer: anwani mbili, tarehe, salamu rasmi, kichwa, ujumbe, hitimisho
